description: fz-go4.18.12 finding 3 (feedstock item 3 root-caused; affects main + every macro function on every fixture, not macro-specific). Two independent requesters (SeedRoot and DeriveRecursive/DeriveDispatchMask) enqueue the same producer as a wait-restart follow_up; when the second enqueue lands AFTER the producer already concluded, the scheduler runs a full byte-identical re-execution (second fire concludes changed:[] with identical lowered_body/entry_dispatch) instead of observing the fact already exists. FIX: suppress the enqueue (or no-op the run) when the awaited fact already exists / the producer already concluded unchanged. Locus: the jobs' JobEffects wait_on_current follow-ups + Scheduler::enqueue dedup. ACCEPTANCE: DeriveDispatchMask/DeriveRecursive/LowerFunction/PlanEntryDispatch/BuildMacroExecutable fire 1x per key on the corpus (any re-fire justified by a real input revision); suite green 3x.
title: Late follow_up enqueue re-runs concluded producers identically (LowerFunction/PlanEntryDispatch/DeriveDispatchMask/BuildMacroExecutable 2x)
